name: The Ultimate Fighter 21: American Top Team vs. Blackzilians

_provenance.note: Drafted from the source article by scripts/tuf/import_season.mjs, which reads the bracket templates and the episode summaries separately and joins them. Where the two disagree the bout carries no winner and the disagreement is recorded in _conflicts. Finale results are not asserted here; they are verified against our own result rows in seasons.json.

_conflicts.detail: This season has no tournament bracket, and recording one would misdescribe it. The source records 12 bouts as a scored gym-versus-gym series: results were worth points to a gym rather than a place in a next round, and what a win was worth rose as the season went on. The bouts are kept in the order the source lists them, with no rounds invented to hold them.

12 bout(s) appear in the episode summaries but in no bracket: Kamarudeen Usman def. Michael Graves; Luiz Firmino def. Uros Jurisic; Valdir Araújo def. Steve Carl; Carrington Banks def. Sabah Homasi; Hayder Hassan def. Andrews Nakahara; Jason Jackson def. Marcelo Alfaya; Vicente Luque def. Nathan Coy; Hayder Hassan def. Felipe Portela; Kamarudeen Usman def. Steve Carl; Nathan Coy def. Valdir Araújo; Michael Graves def. Jason Jackson; Hayder Hassan def. Vicente Luque. Left unplaced rather than assigned to a division by guesswork.

format_exceptions.detail: Before the fight, Graves appears to have injured his neck but he is still going to fight.

team_competition.format: gym versus gym, decided on points
team_competition.note: Two gyms rather than two coaches, and no tournament bracket. Each result was worth points to a gym — 25 early in the season, then 50, then 100 — so the season was won on points rather than by a last fighter standing. American Top Team took it with fewer wins than Blackzilians.

concluding_bout.note: Contested on the finale card, on a sanctioned UFC card, months after the series it concluded. It decided the individual contract; the gym competition was already decided on points.

stages.label: Gym versus gym
stages.note: This season was scored, not bracketed: each result was worth points to a gym rather than a place in a next round, and the points rose as the season went on. The bouts are listed in the order the source gives them.
